tutorial.lead3d: You hold 3♦, so you start. Tap the 3♦ (you can add cards that make a pair, triple or 5-card hand), then tap Play.
tutorial.beatIt: Someone played. Beat it with the same number of cards but higher, or tap Pass.
tutorial.freeLead: Everyone passed, so you lead! Play anything: a single, pair, triple or 5-card hand.
tutorial.order: Order: 3 is lowest, then up to K, A, and 2 is highest. Suits: ♦ < ♣ < ♥ < ♠.
tutorial.goal: Empty your hand first. Everyone else takes a point for each card left.

bigtwo: Get rid of all your cards first.
Ranks: 3 lowest, then 4 to K, A, and 2 highest. Suits: ♦ < ♣ < ♥ < ♠.
Whoever holds 3♦ starts, and the first play must include it.
Play a single, pair, triple or a 5-card hand. You must play the same number of cards as the last play, and beat it.
5-card hands, low to high: straight, flush, full house, four of a kind + 1, straight flush.
A straight is 5 in a row from 3 up to 2 (J-Q-K-A-2 is the highest). No wrapping.
A better suit wins between flushes; within a suit, the highest card wins.
When everyone else passes, the last player to play leads anything.
Standard: the round ends when someone goes out. Others score a point per card left; 10 to 12 cards count double, 13 triple.
Fight Till The End: play on until one player still holds cards. 1st scores 0, each later place +1, and last also adds cards left.

round_start.text: Cards dealt. {name} holds {card} and goes first. Focus, everyone!
Shuffle done. {name} starts with {card}. Who's crying first?

bomb.text: BOOM! {name} dropped {combo}! Only a bigger 5-card hand can beat that.
{name} brought {combo} to a card game. Respect.

all_passed.text: Nobody could beat {name}'s {combo}. {name} leads again, any cards!
Pass, pass, pass. {name} wins the trick and starts fresh.
{name} runs this table now. Free lead!

two_early.text: {name} slapped down {combo} already! Spending the big cards early, bold.
Alamak, {name} uses a 2 so early ah? Still {n} cards left!
{name} played {combo}. That's the top single, hard to beat!

big_play.text: {name} played {combo}! Five cards gone in one go.
Ooh, {combo} from {name}. Can anyone top that?

pass_streak.text: Walao, {name} passed {n} times in a row. Saving cards for CNY?
{name} keeps passing. Patience, your moment is coming.

too_slow.text: Too slow, {name}! The bot played for you.
{name} went to makan, is it? Auto-played.
{name}'s timer ran out, so the bot moved. Next time faster!

double_it.text: {name} was too slow 3 times. Penalty points this round are DOUBLED!
Slowpoke tax! {name} pays double this round.

one_card.text: {name} has ONE card left! Play high or they win!
Last card for {name}! Don't lead a small single!

player_out.text: {name} escapes in place #{place}. The rest of you, keep fighting!

win.text: Champion {name}! Everyone else counts their leftover cards.

out_on_two.text: {name} finished on a 2! House rule: that's LAST place. Ouch.
A 2 to finish, {name}? Bold. Also: last. Very last.
{name} goes out with a 2… straight to the bottom of the table!

last_place.text: {name} lost, but with style. Sort of.

unbeatable.text: {name} played {combo}! Nothing beats that, so everyone passes. {name} leads again!
Walao, {combo} from {name}! Table auto-pass. Bow down.
{combo}?! {name} just told the whole table to sit down.

unstoppable.text: {name} played {combo} and has ONE card left with the lead. It's over, folks!
GG already! {name} dropped {combo} and only has one card left. Nobody can stop it.
{name} with {combo} and one card left. Pack up, go home!

l7_gift.text: {name} grabs the {card} {giver} threw away. Thanks for the gift!
{giver} gave away a {card} for free? {name} says terima kasih!
{name} was waiting for that {card}. {giver}, why like that?

l7_lock.text: {name} locks one of {victim}'s cards. No escape now!
Padlock! {victim}'s card is stuck. Hope it's a good one, {victim}.
{name} slaps a K on {victim}'s card. Locked in!

l7_lock_self.text: {name} locks their own card. Confident or desperate?
{name} is protecting something. Must be a good card… right?

l7_shuffle.text: Spin spin spin! {victim}, whatever you remembered is gone.

l7_swap.text: {name} swaps a card with {victim}. Watch where they went!
A blind swap: {name} and {victim} trade cards. Neither knows what they got.
{name} hands {victim} a mystery card and takes one back. Good deal or bad?

l7_dump.text: {name} threw away a {card}! That's practically zero points, lah.
A {card} on Discard… {next}, are you seeing this?
{name} tossed a {card}. Somebody grab it before it's gone!
Throwing away a {card}? Bold, {name}. Very bold.

l7_final_lap.text: Final lap! One card each left in the deck. Make it count!
Last round of draws! Timers are halved. Panic!
Final lap. Whatever you're hiding, it's almost reveal time.

l7_win.text: {name} wins with {total} points! Lucky or clever?
{name} takes it with {total}. {last}, {worst} points… better luck next time!

l7_zero.text: ZERO points! {name} is the luckiest person alive!
A perfect zero for {name}. Somebody check their sleeves!

l7_dump_low.text: A {card} goes to Discard. Not bad, not great.
{name} lets go of a {card}. Hmm, they must have better.

l7_bait_9.text: {name} throws a 9 right when {next} needs one for that lock. Generous!
A 9 on Discard and {next} is locked… {name}, are you two friends?
{next}, the 9 you prayed for is right there. Thank {name} later.

l7_bait_power.text: {name} threw away a {power} card! {next}, it's all yours.
A free {power} on Discard. {next} is smiling already.

l7_swap_out_good.text: {name} just swapped OUT a {card}! That was a good one…
Oops! {name} gave up a {card} without knowing. Pain.
A {card} lands on Discard from {name}'s own hand. Unlucky!

l7_swap_out_high.text: Bye bye {card}! {name} finally got rid of it.

l7_revenge.text: {victim} started it, {name} finishes it. Payback time!
What goes around comes around, {victim}. {name} remembers.

l7_grudge.text: Everybody's picking on {victim}. Leave them alone lah!
{victim} is the table's favourite target tonight.

l7_halfway.text: Halfway through the deck. {left} cards to go. Remember your cards?
{left} cards left. Who's actually winning? Nobody knows!

l7_last_card.text: Last card in the deck! {name} gets the final say.
One card left, and it's {name}'s. No pressure.
This is it, {name}. The very last card. Make it count!

l7_close.text: By ONE point! {name} edges out {second}. So close!
{name} wins by a single point. {second} is in pain.

l7_peek_own.text: {name} checks their own cards. Memorise fast!
{name} takes a good look at their cards. Poker face on!
{name} is studying their hand. Remember it before someone shuffles it!

l7_peek_other.text: {name} sneaks a look at one of {victim}'s cards. 👀
{victim}, {name} just saw one of your cards. Hmm.
{name} spies on {victim}. Now they know something you don't!

zb_start.text: {pairs} pairs gone already. One Zombie left somewhere. Not me, I swear.
Somebody here is holding the Zombie. Look at their face!
Deal done. Somebody's poker face is about to crack.

zb_pair.text: Pair of {rank}s for {name}. One step closer to safety.

zb_safe.text: {name} is SAFE! Out of the graveyard.
{name} is out. Lucky or clever? Both lah.

zb_two_left.text: Down to {a} and {b}. One of you is the Zombie.

zb_lose.text: The Zombie changed hands {moves} times and stopped at {name}.
{name}, the Zombie chose you. Next round, revenge!

powerHelp.J: Either see all your own cards, or peek at one card of someone else's, for {n} s. Only you see them. Locked cards stay hidden.
powerHelp.Q: Swap one of your cards with one of theirs. Nobody sees them.
powerHelp.K: Lock any card. Locked cards can't be peeked, swapped or shuffled.
powerHelp.T: Shuffle one player's unlocked cards, yours or theirs.

l7.pickLocked: Pick a locked card to free, or skip
l7.pickPeek: Look at all your cards, or tap one card of someone else's
l7.setupHint: Lowest total wins. 7 = 0, A = 1, J Q K = 10.

zb.title: Zombie
zb.setupHint: Old Maid with a Zombie. Throw your pairs, pick from the next player, and don't be the one left holding the Zombie.
zb.yourTurn: YOUR TURN · tap one of their cards
zb.youreSafe: You're SAFE ({place}). Watch the Zombie hunt!
help: 53 cards: the deck plus one Joker, the Zombie. First everyone throws their pairs (same rank): tap a glowing pair, or Throw all.
On your turn the next player's hand shuffles itself. Tap one of their cards to point at it (they see it too), then tap it again or Take it.
If it makes a pair, tap the pair to throw it. Turn on Auto-throw below to skip the tapping.
15 s to pick, 10 s to throw, then the game does it for you.
Empty hand: you're SAFE. The last one holding the Zombie loses.
zb.throwYourPairs: Tap a glowing pair to throw it
zb.confirmPick: Tap it again (or Take it) to take it
zb.theyPick: They're picking one of YOUR cards…
